blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bangsamoro civic group AMANA BARMM has urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to meet Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) chair Al Haj Murad Ebrahim before the Bangsamoro Parliament opens on Oct. 30, saying the talks could help advance the decades-long peace process. In a statement on Monday, the group said a meeting between Marcos and Murad could help bring an end to a conflict that began 50 years ago. It cited the need to complete the peace process and address the pending disarmament of former MILF fighters. “Fifty years. Twenty months. One meeting,” said Sultan Alim Saad Amate, AMANA’s […]...
